import React from 'react'
  import { MDXTag } from '@mdx-js/tag'
  import { Playground } from 'docz'
import { Button, ButtonGroup } from './src'
import { Icon } from '../icon/src'
import { Box } from '../layout/src'
import { Paragraph } from '../typography/src'

const layoutProps = {
  
};
export default class MDXContent extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props)
    this.layout = null
  }
  render() {
    const { components, ...props } = this.props

    return <MDXTag
             name="wrapper"
             
             components={components}>
<MDXTag name="h1" components={components} props={{"id":"button"}}>{`Button`}</MDXTag>
<ButtonGroup>
  <Button>Hello, World</Button>
  <Button secondary>Hello, World</Button>
  <Button tertiary>Hello, World</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"basic-usage"}}>{`Basic Usage`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="pre" components={components}><MDXTag name="code" components={components} parentName="pre" props={{"className":"language-js"}}>{`import Button from '@rtm-ui/button'

...

<Button>Sign In</Button>
`}</MDXTag></MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"styles"}}>{`Styles`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}><MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`<Button>`}</MDXTag>{` takes a `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`secondary`}</MDXTag>{` prop for alternate backgrounds`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={1} __code={'<Button secondary>Hello, World\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Button,ButtonGroup,Icon,Box,Paragraph}}>
  <Button secondary>Hello, World</Button>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"variants"}}>{`Variants`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`The colors for a button depend on the variant`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={2} __code={'<Box variant=\"b\" p={10}>\n    <Button>Hello, World\n  </Box>\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Button,ButtonGroup,Icon,Box,Paragraph}}>
  <Box variant="b" p={10}>
    <Button >Hello, World</Button>
  </Box>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"tracking"}}>{`Tracking`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Button clicks of any kind can be tracked by providing a `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`track`}</MDXTag>{` prop. Read more about tracking `}<MDXTag name="a" components={components} parentName="p" props={{"href":"/utilities/tracker"}}>{`here`}</MDXTag>{`.`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="pre" components={components}><MDXTag name="code" components={components} parentName="pre" props={{"className":"language-js"}}>{`<Button track="signin">Sign In</Button>
`}</MDXTag></MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"as-an-a-tag"}}>{`As an A tag`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Buttons can be rendered as an `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`a`}</MDXTag>{` tag and given an `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`href`}</MDXTag></MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={3} __code={'<Button as=\"a\" href=\"https://example.com\" track=\"signin\">\n    Sign In\n  \n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Button,ButtonGroup,Icon,Box,Paragraph}}>
  <Button as="a" href="https://example.com" track="signin">Sign In</Button>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"as-a-wrapper"}}>{`As a Wrapper`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Buttons can be rendered as an invisible wrapper`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={4} __code={'<Button onClick={() => alert(\'clicked\')} asWrapper>\n    <Paragraph>Sign In\n  </Button>\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Button,ButtonGroup,Icon,Box,Paragraph}}>
  <Button onClick={() => alert('clicked')} asWrapper><Paragraph>Sign In</Paragraph></Button>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"with-icons"}}>{`With Icons`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Using an icon in a button requires the `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`inline`}</MDXTag>{` prop, which takes the icon's
height out of the equation so the button doesn't occupy more space than it should.`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={5} __code={'<Button>\n    <Icon inline glyph=\"double-check\" />\n    Hello, World\n  \n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Button,ButtonGroup,Icon,Box,Paragraph}}>
  <Button><Icon inline glyph="double-check" />Hello, World</Button>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="h2" components={components} props={{"id":"button-group"}}>{`Button Group`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`The `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`ButtonGroup`}</MDXTag>{` component will handle spacing and collapsing the list
of buttons`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={6} __code={'<ButtonGroup>\n    <Button>Hello, World\n    <Button>Hello, World</Button>\n    <Button>Hello, World</Button>\n  </ButtonGroup>\n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Button,ButtonGroup,Icon,Box,Paragraph}}>
  <ButtonGroup>
    <Button>Hello, World</Button>
    <Button>Hello, World</Button>
    <Button>Hello, World</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
</Playground>
           </MDXTag>
  }
}
